FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, phone: 555-123-4567, email: john.smith@surplusmilitarygear.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Surplus Military Gear & Supply Co., we specialize in retailing high-quality military surplus items sourced exclusively from domestic government auctions and approved military surplus wholesalers. Our operations include a diverse range of products such as clothing, camping gear, tactical accessories, and outdoor equipment, all carefully selected to meet the needs of outdoor enthusiasts, military personnel, and the general public. We adhere strictly to all regulations, ensuring that we do not engage in the sale of firearms, explosives, or controlled tactical gear without the necessary permits and licenses. Our facility is equipped with comprehensive fire and water protection systems, and we conduct regular inventory appraisals to maintain accurate valuation and compliance with safety standards. Our staff is trained in regulatory compliance and the safe handling of military surplus goods, and we implement robust cybersecurity measures for our online sales to protect customer data. We take pride in providing a safe shopping environment while ensuring adherence to compliance and security protocols.

Our store sources military surplus items from various international suppliers, including certain foreign military entities, to provide a diverse range of products for our customers.
